book.name: LUUKA
book.title: oMwazi Mwinja gwa Yeesu Krisitu nk'oku LUUKA aguyandikaga

content: Yeesu asidaakwa embere za Pilaato
Bala bantu booshi babaaga bali omu kabuga k'aBayaahudi bayimanga, baheeka Yeesu embere z'omwimangizi Pilaato.

Barhondera kumusidaaka, baderha ntya: «Rhwabugaanire oyu muntu ali ararusa olubaga lwerhu; ali abuza guhaana ekooli emwa mwami mukulu Kayizaari, anali achiiderha yenyine oku ali Krisitu, k'okuderha mwami.»
Pilaato amubaza ntya: «Ka wooyo oli mwami w'aBayaahudi?» Yeesu amushubiza ntya: «Wooyo, we waderhere ntyo.»
Pilaato abwira abakulu b'abadaahwa n'olubaga lw'abantu ntya: «Ntaacho nabwene emw'oyu muntu chagarhuma ahanwa.»
Aliko, baharhiiriza n'okuderha ntya: «Enyigirizo zaage yi zaarhuma abantu balwisa abakulu omu Yudeeya yooshi. Arhangiriraga eGalilaaya, leero ali kuno.»
Yeesu embere za mwami Heroode
Pilaato abeere ayunva ebyoola, abaza akaba oyu muntu aliiri Mugalilaaya.
Abeere amenya oku Yeesu arhengera omu gihugo girhegekerwe na Heroode, amurhuma emwa Heroode, kwenge naye aliiri eYerusaleema mw'ezoola siku.
Heroode abeere abona Yeesu, ashagaluka bweneene. Gurhengera miira, aliiri ashonda kumubona kwenge abaaga ayunviirhe emyaazi yaage. Na kandi, aliiri alangaalira okubona Yeesu ajira egisomereene.
Heroode amubaziiriza, aliko Yeesu ntaacho amushubize.
Abakulu b'abadaahwa n'abigiriza b'amarhegeko baliiri ahoola, bamusidaaka n'obukali bunene.
Heroode naye, haguma n'abasoda baage, bashekera Yeesu n'okumukena. Bamalire kumushekera n'okumuyambisa omwambalo gukwiriire bweneene, ashuba kugalula Yeesu emwa Pilaato.
Olo lusiku, Heroode na Pilaato baaba beera, n'obo embere baliiri banzi.
Yeesu achiirwa olushinja mpw'afe
Pilaato ahamagaza abakulu b'abadaahwa, abimangizi b'aBayaahudi n'abandi bantu.
Ababwira ntya: «Mwandeerheraga oyu muntu bulaala mwaderhaga oku aliiri gurarusa olubaga. Namubazize embere zenyu aliko nyoono ntaacho namubwene ko chagarhuma ahanwa omu byooshi mwamusidakiire.
Heroode naye ntaacho amubwene ko, kwenge arhugaluliire ye. Ntaacho omu by'ajirire chagarhuma ayirhwa.
Boboola enyuma z'okumushuurha, namulikuula.» [
Ngasi lusiku lukulu lw'ePaasaka, Pilaato alikwaneene kubalikuulira omuntu muguma oli omu munyororo.]
Abantu booshi bayaamira chaligumira ntya: «Oyirhe oyu muntu! Orhulikuulire Baraaba!»
Baraaba abaaga ashwekerwe elugulu w'entambala yabaaga omu gishagala n'okuyirha omuntu.
Pilaato ashuba kuderha nabo, kwenge alishondere alikuule Yeesu.
Aliko boowe baalema bayaama ntya: «Omubambe oku musalaaba! Omubambe oku musalaaba!»
Pilaato ababwira ntya obwa gasharhu: «Bubi buchi ajirire? Ntaacho namubwene ko chagarhuma ayirhwa. Enyuma z'okumushuurha, namulikuula.»
Aliko bachihanda n'olwamo lunene, omu guhema abambwe oku musalaaba. Olwamo lwabo lunene lwahimana.
Buzinda, Pilaato arhegeka oku bibe nk'oku abantu baahemaga.
Alikuula ola bashondaga, wali wahirirwe omu munyororo elugulu w'obugome n'okuyirha omuntu; abaheereza Yeesu, bamujire nk'oku balonzaga.
Yeesu abambwa oku musalaaba

Abasoda b'aBarooma babeere bali baheeka Yeesu emunda bamuyirhira, bashimaanana n'omuntu muguma oyirikwa Simooni, w'egishagala ch'eKureene, waliiri gurhenga omu shwa. Baava bamurhoola n'okumuheesa omusalaaba mpu aguheeke enyuma za Yeesu.
Olubaga lunene lw'abantu lwali kulikiire Yeesu. Ahagarhi kaabo haliiri abakazi baliiri balira n'oguchiniguula elugulu waage.
Yeesu abahindamukira n'okubabwira ntya: «Mwe bakazi b'eYerusaleema, murhandiriraga. Aliko muchiilirire n'abaana benyu.
Kwenge esiku zayinjire abantu nji baderha ntya: ‹Bagishirwe abakazi b'engumba, zigishirwe enda zirhashubiraga kuburha n'amabeere marhashubiraga kuyonsa!›
Amo mango, abantu nji barhondera okubwira emisozi ntya: ‹Murhurhogere ko!›, n'okubwira orhusozi ntya: ‹Murhuhambe!›
Bulaala eyi bankajira ebyoola oku murhi mubishi, bichi nji byajirirwa omurhi guyuumire?»
Kandi, abasoda bali baheekere ebishumuusi bibiri, byaali byaaja kuyirhwa haguma na Yeesu.
Babeere baagera ahantu hayirikwa Mpanga, bamubambira ahoola oku musalaaba, na bila bishumuusi bibiri, chiguma ekulyo n'echindi ekulembe.
[Yeesu aderha ntya: «Daarha, obababalire, kwenge barhamenyere echi bali baajira.»]
Abasoda bagabaana emyambalo yaage omu kuyeesha esimbi.

Abantu baliyimangire ahoola, baanali baalola. Abarhegesi b'aBayaahudi boowe, bashinyagulira Yeesu, baderha ntya: «Achungwire abandi; agichungule yenyine, akaba ali Krisitu, ola Nnamahanga agishogere!»
Abasoda nabo baliiri bamushekera. Bayinja kumuha edivaayi y'enkala,
n'okumubwira ntya: «Akaba oli mwami w'aBayaahudi, ogifumye wenyine!»
Haliiri kandi elugulu waage ogu mwandiko: «Oyu ye Mwami w'aBayaahudi.»
Muguma omu bishumuusi bibambirwe oku musalaaba amudukanga ntya: «K'orhali we Krisitu? Ochifumye wenyine onarhufumye!»
Aliko echindi gishumuusi chakalihira echaabo ntya: «K'orhagwerhe chiro obuuba bwa Nnamahanga, wooyo weeri waahanwa kuguma naye?
Oku rhwewe, obuhane burhukwaneene, kwenge rhuli rhwayankirira egikwaneene ebijiro byeerhu. Aliko oyuula nta chibi n'echiguma ajirire.»
Ashuba kuderha ntya: «Yeesu, onyibuke hano nj'oja omu Bwami bwawe.»
Yeesu amushubiza ntya: «Okuli, nkubwirire, zeene waaba haguma naani omu Paradizo
Olufu lwa Yeesu
Zaali zikola zashonda kuba saa ndarhu; haaba omwizimya oku gihugo chooshi kugera aha saa mwenda,
kwenge ezuuba lyalihirimire. N'omwenda
gw'omu Nju ya Nnamahanga gwachisharhula ahagarhi.
Yeesu ayaama ntya: «Daarha, mpirire omurhima gwani omu fune zaawe.»
Amalire kuderha ebyoola, asimuuka.
Omukulu w'abasoda abeere abona ebyabeere, akuuza Nnamahanga n'okuderha ntya: «Okuli, oyu muntu aliiri okwaneene!»
Abantu booshi balichigushire ahoola kulola kw'eyo myaazi, babwene ebyabeere, bagaluka emwabo n'amaganya manene.
Booshi baliyinji Yeesu, n'abakazi baliiri bamuherekeeze gurhengera eGalilaaya, bayimanga hale, baalola ebiri byaaba.
Yeesu ahambwa

Haliiri mulume muguma oyirikwa Yozefu wahulukiraga eHarimateya, gishagala chiguma ch'aBayaahudi. Aliiri muntu mwinja onakwaneene, anagendaga alinga obwime bwa Nnamahanga. Aliiri muguma w'akabuga k'aBayaahudi, aliko arhaali yemereere omuhigo n'ebijiro byaabo by'okuyirha Yeesu.
Aja emwa Pilaato, ahema omubiri gwa Yeesu.
Aguyandagaza oku musalaaba, aguzingira kw'edaraape, aguhira omu shinda yajokolwaga omu baale. Mweyo shinda, mwabaaga murhashubiraga guhaabwa muntu.
Olo lusiku, lwaliiri lwagarhaano, lo lwanaliiri lusiku l'ogurheganya eSaabato, n'eSaabato yali kola gurhondera.
Balaala bakazi baliiri barhengeere eGalilaaya haguma na Yeesu, bakulikira Yozefu. Baabona eshinda n'obulyo bahiraga mo omubiri gwa Yeesu.
Bagaluka gurheganya amavurha n'amarashi. Olusiku lw'eSaabato, bahumuuka, gukulikirana n'eRhegeko lya Nnamahanga.
